title: Director of Manufacturing Operations
text:
Director of Manufacturing Operations

$180,000 - $200,000 + 20% Bonus + High Autonomy + Technical Challenges + Training + Career Progression + Build & Lead High Performing Operation + PTO & Holiday + Benefits

Miami, Fort Lauderdale, Florida (Relocation Package)

Are you a Director of Operations from a food, beverage of CPG background looking for an executive leadership role where you can take full ownership of manufacturing operations?

Do you want to build, develop and enhance world-class operations for a business heavily investing in new products, technology and equipment for long-term growth?

On offer is the chance to strategically lead end to end manufacturing operations, working closely with the COO on key projects. You’ll work with engineering, maintenance, production, warehouse and distribution teams to optimize efficiencies, reduce cost, improve safety and drive plant performance to become world class. This role has a strong focus around CAPEX projects, planning, financial budgeting and analysis. On offer is the chance to work with high autonomy through technical challenges with upward career progression long-term as this organization continues to invest and dominate their market.

This opportunity will suit a proven operational expert, looking to work with autonomy, through technical challenges in a high growth, leading manufacturing business.

**The Role:**

* Autonomously lead, develop an enhance world class manufacturing operations for a fast growing business investing heavily in continued success
* Work closely with COO and senior leadership teams to take operational performance to the next level
* Lead CAPEX expenditure from concept to completion, manage financial analysis and budgeting
* Enhance production efficiency, product quality, safety, and drive savings
* Future career progression opportunities, bonus, relocation package and full company benefits on offer

**The Person:**

* Director of Manufacturing Operations, in either Food, Beverage or CPG
* Engineering Degree (Mechanical, Electrical or similar field)
* Proven experience leading and enhancing manufacturing operations
* Understanding of AI and how to leverage it to improve plant performance

To apply for this role or to be considered for further roles, please click "Apply Now" or contact Ryan Adams at Rise Technical Recruitment.
